args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, 8 accepted. Flagged: 2. Cleared: 6.
Flagged as remedy_pattern: r04 and r06. Both kept frame registration on tissue from 400 px from the tip, treated as non-growing. That reference likely lies inside the growth zone, which peaks at 421 µm and is 684 µm long. This assumes about 1 µm per pixel; the records don't give the pixel scale. Their largest flank difference sits at 295 µm against a batch median of 63 µm (z 7.45), so their curvature-rate profile is a different shape. All their checks pass. Their REGR peak z of 7.42 is only 0.11 %/h and on its own would just mean a slightly faster root.
Cleared: r01, r02, r05, r07, r03, r08. Rigid invariance and closure pass for all six. Plane sections passes for r01 and r02 and is not run for the four width-free runs. Summaries are at or near the batch median.
Common to the flagged runs: identical kept registration from 400 px and a flank-difference maximum far from the tip. r03 and r08 kept the same registration but have a batch-like profile: growth zone 10 µm shorter, peak 0.02 %/h lower, flank difference at 84 µm. They were cleared, but they are worth rechecking if the 400 px reference is confirmed to lie inside the growth zone.
